description: Sign in to Microsoft Teams, inspect bounded chat history, and send only to an explicitly owner-approved chat.
configHelp: Use the plugin page header's Configure with AI button. Run `codeterm plugin teams-client login` to start Microsoft 365 work or school sign-in. Show the returned signInUrl and deviceCode to the user, then poll `codeterm plugin teams-client login-status` and confirm with `codeterm plugin teams-client health`. A tenant administrator may need to approve the m365 CLI app's consent. The Teams Client view retains its browser sign-in flow as an alternative. The pinned m365 CLI installs into the plugin-owned runtime path when Node.js 20+ and npm are available. This plugin enables `agent_commands`. Agent verbs include `accounts`, `use <account-id>`, `chats`, `history <chat-id> [n]`, `health`, `logout`, `login`, `login-status`, `preview <chat-id> <text>`, and `send <chat-id> [--key <idempotency-key>] <text>`. Refresh chats, choose an immutable chat id, inspect the preview including sender tenant and exact text, then explicitly approve that one chat in the view before sending is enabled. There is no default send policy. History is capped at 50 messages and 32 KiB.
